name: LXRXXL BAZZLINE
author: L'Cronx
summary: An 8-track bass synth: a variation of LXRXXL with bass voices built after the open-source Erica Synths Bassline on the LXR's oscillators (VCO/FM/wavetable, sub, swarm, drive, Polivoks or diode filter, accent, slide), the LXR-02 style sequencer with the DB-01's step functions, a tape/digital delay and a MIDI gate/duck. Three full-screen pages of artwork by Suns Kiefer, with an 8-track mixer (pan, delay send, level, mute, solo). Not a DB-01; no Erica Synths code. Non-commercial license.
